svg.aria-label: A replots published cumulative mass data from Ross and Frolen, NBS (1972), Table 4; the mass median uses linear interpolation in log M, preserving all printed values. B is a separate constructed population of 90 chains at 10,000 g/mol and 10 at 100,000 g/mol, compared by number and mass.
